description: Establish the socket connection to the CFD proxy server. A port number may be specified with the port keyword if the proxy server has been configured to operate on a port other than port 2500.

keywords.name: density
keywords.description: The fluid density of all CFD elements is set to f. A nonzero density must be specified.

keywords.name: viscosity
keywords.description: The fluid viscosity of all CFD elements is set to f. A nonzero viscosity must be specified.

keywords.name: port
keywords.description: Port of the CFD proxy server; by default port 2500.

examples.description: Connect to the CFD proxy server with the required fluid density and viscosity

notes: The density and viscosity keywords are required: without them the command is rejected with 'The element fluid density and viscosity must be specified' on 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8.
A CCFD proxy server (the GiD-based CFD program) must be listening on the port for the connection to succeed.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): rejected without density/viscosity on all three consoles; with 'port 2525 density 1000 viscosity 0.001' the engine attempts the socket connection and fails cleanly without a server ('CCFD Socket not connected' on 9.8, 'CCFD Socket write error' on 7.00) - no proxy server was available for a full coupling test.
